question: The initiative of jail tourism, a first of its kind, was launched in January 2021 in the state of ________.
solution:
The correct answer is **__Maharashtra.__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **The Maharashtra** government will start **'jail tourism'** in the state from **Pune's Yerawada prison on January 26, 2021.**
 
• It will facilitate people to** visit and see from close quarters the historical prisons**.
 
• This is the** first of its kind initiative in the country.**
 
• Under British rule, several freedom fighters, including **Mahatma Gandhi had been imprisoned in Yerawada jail.​**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• **Maharashtra:**

 
 
• **Chief Minister - Uddhav Thackeray (As of Jan 2022).**
 
• **Governor - Bhagat Singh Koshyari **(As of Jan 2022)**.**
 
• **Number of Districts - 36.**
